subject: general
question:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

Johnsy was so angry with the stranger that she threw her sandals to him hurting just above his right eyebrow.

options.text: stranger that she threw her sandals to him
hurting just above his right eyebrow.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. stranger that she threw her sandals to him .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in part 3 of the sentence: **"stranger that she threw her sandals to him."**
 
• The preposition **"to"** is incorrectly used in this context. The correct preposition should be **"at."**
 
• The correct phrase is: **"she threw her sandals at him."**
 
• The preposition **"at"** is used when directing an action toward someone or something in a forceful or targeted manner.

Correct sentence: *Johnsy was so angry with the stranger that she threw her sandals at him, hurting just above his right eyebrow.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of "to" vs. "at":**

 
 
• **"To":** Indicates direction or movement toward a destination (e.g., "I gave the book to her.").
 
• **"At":** Indicates a targeted or aggressive action (e.g., "He threw a ball at the wall.").
